what_they_do: Zalion builds modular AI agents that automate industrial procurement, covering intake (clarifying purchasing needs via Teams chat and creating requisitions in SAP), sourcing (drafting RFQs, chasing suppliers, comparing offers), negotiation (benchmarking quotes against historical/market data), and order verification (matching POs against confirmations and syncing to ERP). It replaces the manual, email-and-spreadsheet-driven work of procurement teams at manufacturers who currently chase suppliers, reconcile quotes, and cross-check orders by hand.
theme_fit_rationale: Theme 2 fits directly: procurement is listed as an explicit use case, and Zalion's agents read/write across chat, SAP, and supplier communications while holding state across a long-running intake-to-order workflow, consolidating a fragmented set of manual steps into one system. Theme 5 fits secondarily: the order verification agent's core wedge is matching unstructured documents (POs, order confirmations, invoices) against each other to flag discrepancies, a document-processing wedge into a broader procurement workflow.
recent_signals: Hosted an invite-only roundtable at the BME European Procurement & Supply Chain Excellence Summit in Berlin (Apr 21) on 2026 target architecture for ERP vs. agents vs. suites in procurement
Actively hiring a Founding Growth Lead and a Head of US (New York) alongside five Munich engineering roles, signaling a push into US expansion
